description: Defines classes and methods for managing uplink context and repository in a wireless communication system, including resource grid handling, context management, and concurrency control.

classes.name: uplink_context
classes.description: Represents the uplink resource grid context, including methods for writing RE IQ buffers, checking completeness, and copying context.

classes.name: uplink_context_resource_grid_info
classes.description: Holds information about the resource grid context and shared resource grid.

classes.name: uplink_context_repository
classes.description: Manages a collection of uplink contexts, supporting concurrent access, addition, retrieval, and clearing of contexts.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the uplink_context instance.

methods.name: try_getting_complete_resource_grid
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a complete resource grid if all PRBs are written.

methods.name: pop_uplink_context_resource_grid_info
methods.description: Returns and clears the stored resource grid info.

methods.name: write_grid
methods.description: Writes IQ buffer data into the resource grid at specified port and RE start.

methods.name: have_all_prbs_been_written
methods.description: Checks if all PRBs for the current symbol have been written.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Enqueues a new uplink context into the repository for specified slot and symbols.

methods.name: process_pending_contexts
methods.description: Processes all enqueued context addition tasks.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a copy of the uplink context for a given slot and symbol.

methods.name: try_popping_complete_resource_grid_symbol
methods.description: Attempts to pop a complete resource grid for a specific slot and symbol.

methods.name: pop_resource_grid_symbol
methods.description: Pops and clears the resource grid info for a specific slot and symbol.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the context for a specific slot and symbol.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the entire repository, releasing ownership of shared resource grids.
